PROGRAM_TOOLTIP: Blocks in the first part run once when the board starts. Blocks in the second part repeat over and over.
DIGITAL_WRITE_TOOLTIP: Turns whatever is wired to the pin on (HIGH) or off (LOW): an LED, a relay, a motor through its driver…
DIGITAL_READ_TOOLTIP: True when the pin receives voltage.
ANALOG_READ_TOOLTIP: Reads a voltage as a number from 0 to 1023.
ANALOG_WRITE_TOOLTIP: Sets a level from 0 (off) to 255 (fully on).
DELAY_MS_TOOLTIP: Pauses the program. 1000 milliseconds are one second.
DELAY_SECONDS_TOOLTIP: Pauses the program for a number of seconds.
MILLIS_TOOLTIP: Time since the board started, in milliseconds.
SERIAL_PRINT_TOOLTIP: Sends text or numbers to the serial monitor.
SERIAL_AVAILABLE_TOOLTIP: True when the computer has sent something to the board.
SERIAL_READ_LINE_TOOLTIP: Reads the text sent from the computer, up to the end of the line.
LED_SET_TOOLTIP: Turns an LED on or off.
LED_BRIGHTNESS: set LED brightness on pin %1 to %2 percent
LED_BRIGHTNESS_TOOLTIP: 0 percent is off and 100 percent is full brightness. Needs a PWM pin.
BUZZER_TONE: play a sound on pin %1 at %2 Hz for %3 ms
BUZZER_TONE_TOOLTIP: Plays a note on a buzzer. Higher numbers sound higher.
SERVO_WRITE: move servo on pin %1 to %2 degrees
SERVO_WRITE_TOOLTIP: Turns a servo motor to an angle from 0 to 180 degrees.
BUTTON_PRESSED_TOOLTIP: Connect the button between the pin and GND. No resistor is needed.
POTENTIOMETER_TOOLTIP: Knob position as a number from 0 to 1023.
ULTRASONIC_TOOLTIP: Measures distance with an ultrasonic sensor. Returns 0 when nothing is in range.
MATH_MAP_TOOLTIP: Converts a number from one range to another, for example 0–1023 to 0–100.
RGB_COLOR_TOOLTIP: Lights a common-cathode RGB LED in a colour. Needs three PWM pins.
RGB_MIX_TOOLTIP: Mixes a colour with values from 0 to 255 for red, green and blue.
LCD_PRINT: show %1 on the LCD screen %4 at row %2 column %3
LCD_PRINT_TOOLTIP: Writes text or numbers on the 16x2 I2C screen. Rows go from 1 to 2 and columns from 1 to 16. The screen connects to the SDA and SCL pins, which are fixed on each board (A4 and A5 on the Uno).
NEOPIXEL_SET: turn on light %1 in %3 of the NeoPixel ring with %4 lights on pin %2
NEOPIXEL_SET_TOOLTIP: For NeoPixel (WS2812) strips and rings. Gives a colour to one of its lights, counting from 1. For a plain LED use the Outputs blocks.
NEOPIXEL_CLEAR: turn off the NeoPixel ring with %2 lights on pin %1
NEOPIXEL_CLEAR_TOOLTIP: Turns off every LED of the strip or ring.
SWITCH_ON_TOOLTIP: Slide switch: the middle leg goes to the pin and the outer legs to 5V and GND.
MOTION: motion sensor on pin %1 detects movement
MOTION_TOOLTIP: PIR sensor: turns on when someone moves in front of it and stays on for a few seconds.
TILT: tilt sensor on pin %1 is tilted
TILT_TOOLTIP: Turns on when the sensor is tilted.
TEMPERATURE: temperature in °C from the sensor on pin %1
TEMPERATURE_TOOLTIP: Reads a temperature module with a 10 kΩ NTC thermistor. Needs an analog pin.
LED_ON_FOR: turn on the LED on pin %1 for %2 seconds
LED_ON_FOR_TOOLTIP: Turns the LED on, waits that long and turns it off.
TEXT_LETTER_TOOLTIP: The letter at that position, counting from 1.
TEXT_CONTAINS_TOOLTIP: True when the second text appears inside the first one.
SEVEN_SEGMENT: show the number %1 on the 7-segment display (segment a on pin %2)
SEVEN_SEGMENT_TOOLTIP: Shows a number from 0 to 9. Segments a, b, c, d, e, f and g go on consecutive pins, starting with the chosen one.
JOYSTICK_AXIS_TOOLTIP: A number from −100 to 100: 0 is the centre.
JOYSTICK_PRESSED: joystick button on pin %1 is pressed
JOYSTICK_PRESSED_TOOLTIP: True while the joystick stick is pushed down.
BUILTIN_LED_TOOLTIP: The board has its own LED, marked L. Nothing needs to be wired.
CODE_TOOLTIP: C++ code that has no block. It is copied into the program as is.
CODE_GLOBAL_TOOLTIP: C++ code that goes before setup(): libraries, variables or functions. It is copied as is.
DELAY_US_TOOLTIP: A very short pause: 1000 microseconds are one millisecond. Useful for sensors that need quick pulses.
DIGITAL_WRITE_VALUE: set digital pin %1 to the value %2
DIGITAL_WRITE_VALUE_TOOLTIP: Turns the pin on when the value is true (or not zero) and off when it is false. Useful with a variable.
PULSE_IN: length of a %1 pulse on pin %2 (µs)
PULSE_IN_TOOLTIP: Waits for a pulse on the pin and measures how long it lasts, in microseconds. Gives 0 if none arrives within a second.
BUZZER_TONE_START: start sounding on pin %1 at %2 Hz
BUZZER_TONE_START_TOOLTIP: The buzzer keeps sounding while the program goes on, until you use "stop the sound".
